mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_purchase (user_seq, platform, product_id, transaction_id, receipt, points_granted, bonus_points, amount_krw, status) VALUES (#{userSeq}, #{platform}, #{productId}, #{transactionId}, #{receipt}, #{pointsGranted}, #{bonusPoints}, #{amountKrw}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_purchase WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_purchase SET status = 'VERIFIED', verified_at = NOW() WHERE purchase_seq = #{purchaseSeq}
